title: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: Suppose your university is selecting some students to teach kids in remote rural areas during the coming vacation. You are now to write an application letter to the university to explain why you want to take part and what you can do for the kids. You will have 30 minutes to write the letter. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply for the position of a volunteer teacher for children in remote rural areas during the coming vacation. The main reason I want to take part is my genuine love for education. Two years ago, I tutored a left-behind child in my hometown, and watching her grow more confident convinced me that teaching can truly change lives. Joining this program is my way of giving back to society. As for what I can do, I major in English, so I am confident that I can teach the kids basic spoken English and help them with their homework. Besides, I enjoy singing and drawing, and I would like to organize after-class activities to make learning both fun and warm for them. I would sincerely appreciate it if I could be given this valuable chance. Thank you for your time and consideration. Yours sincerely, Li Hua
keyPoints: 称呼立格式。首行 Dear Sir or Madam, 落实『顶格称呼定语域』,一眼确立这是正式信件、 定下语域。
来意＋经历撑动机。先 I am writing to apply for... 表来意,再用『Two years ago, I tutored a left-behind child... convinced me that teaching can truly change lives』的亲身经历坐实动机,兑现 『先来意后讲理由』,答满第一个任务点。
一硬一软配需求。As for what I can do 过渡后,给出『teach the kids basic spoken English』(硬)与『organize after-class activities』(软)两项贡献,落实『能力配需求』,答满第二个任 务点。
情态动词软化语气。用 would/could(『I would sincerely appreciate it if I could be given this valuable chance』)委婉表期待,再一句致谢,兑现『礼貌收束致谢』。
